qa_pairs.question: Which component types use the lever to pedal value sender specification?
What vehicle types does the pedal value sender to pedal console specification apply to?
What is the difference in torque between the lever to pedal value sender and the pedal value sender to pedal console?
qa_pairs.answer: The lever to pedal value sender requires 9 Nm while the pedal value sender to pedal console requires 5 Nm, a difference of 4 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers these sender specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: 12-16 Engine Electrical System, subsection 12 72 Senders for Control Unit

qa_pairs.question: Which sender specification has the higher torque requirement?
qa_pairs.answer: The lever to pedal value sender (1AZ) has the higher torque requirement at 9 Nm compared to 5 Nm for the pedal value sender to pedal console (2AZ).
